title: One Model, All Roles: Multi-Turn, Multi-Agent Self-Play Reinforcement Learning for Conversational Social Intelligence
reasoning: The paper investigates conversational social intelligence by evaluating traits such as empathy, persuasion, and cooperation within multi-agent game-like environments (e.g., Werewolf and SOTOPIA). It does not engage with religion, formal moral reasoning, or ethical frameworks beyond general social rule compliance in tactical conversation contexts.
